mapper.select: SELECT c.*, c.authorNickname AS displayName FROM ct_comment c WHERE c.boardId = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.commentId ASC
SELECT * FROM ct_comment WHERE commentId = #{commentId} AND boardId = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ct_comment(boardId, authorType, authorNickname, content, authorProfileImageId) VALUES(#{boardId}, #{authorType}, #{authorNickname}, #{content}, #{authorProfileImageId})
mapper.update: UPDATE ct_comment SET content = #{content} WHERE commentId = #{commentId} AND boardId = #{boardId} AND authorType = 'PLAYER'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ct_comment WHERE commentId = #{commentId} AND boardId = #{boardId} AND authorType = 'PLAYER'
